True transparent alpha, no cast shadows, no text/effects/scenery. Project target GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst/max, host selectors unavailable.

frames.sourcePrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit image 1 locally, ONLY the SCREEN-RIGHT LOWER boot below its white ankle wrap. This boy is running NORTH-EAST, away toward the upper RIGHT. His right-front boot is wrongly facing the viewer's lower-left. Redraw that boot with its TOE pointing away to the upper RIGHT, heel facing us at the lower LEFT. Image 2 is the user-approved NE reference: copy ONLY the physical heel/toe orientation, with an identifiable BACK HEEL counter and vertical center seam visible near the camera, and the toe extending farther RIGHT behind the ankle. Use the boy's black leather, gold trim and separate block heel, never green. Keep the screen-left lifted back foot and its visible sole exactly. Keep this frame 13's ankle location, height and lower leg angle; do not lengthen the calf, move the body or change leg phase. The character must retain all original pixels visually above the white ankle wrap: same head size, brown hair, ponytail, golden ribbons/turquoise beads, torso, robe, legs, shoulders, hands, gold pointed scepter anatomical RIGHT, rectangular taiji plaque LEFT. Image 3 locks approved illustration style. Preserve the exact full-body canvas framing and scale, no new shadows or background, true transparent alpha. Do not show a round gold TOE cap at the near lower-left end: it must be a flat BACK HEEL with separate heel block. Target GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst / max; host selectors unavailable.
